Bundled open-source runtime files:

A-Frame 1.6.0 (includes Three.js and other credited dependencies)
https://github.com/aframevr/aframe/tree/v1.6.0
Commit: e6c47761f1eaf5b5e65369d562c149e8eeb71532
License: MIT, see AFRAME-LICENSE.txt and bundled notices.

aframe-ar-nft.js and ar-threex-location-only.js, AR.js 3.4.8
https://github.com/AR-js-org/AR.js/tree/3.4.8
Commit: 147ccd4170bb153f64d7fd9858eaff1d3294990c
License: AR.js code is MIT. The included artoolkit5-js portions are LGPLv3
with additional permission, as documented by the upstream AR.js README:
https://github.com/AR-js-org/AR.js#licenses
Corresponding upstream source and notices: https://github.com/AR-js-org/AR.js
and https://github.com/artoolkitx/jsartoolkit5
See ARJS-LICENSE.txt, LGPL-3.txt, GPL-3.txt and bundled notices.
AR.js runtime has small lifecycle modifications, reproduced by tools/patch_arjs.py.
The camera-source class is exposed so camera-lifecycle.js can safely handle late
permission grants; resize callbacks and initialization stop safely after removal.

Hiro image, marker pattern, and default camera calibration are from AR.js 3.4.8:
https://github.com/AR-js-org/AR.js/blob/3.4.8/data/images/hiro.png
https://github.com/AR-js-org/AR.js/blob/3.4.8/data/data/patt.hiro
https://github.com/AR-js-org/AR.js/blob/3.4.8/data/data/camera_para.dat
Hiro is used only for marker tracking; no NFT image target is used.

Interaction-pattern references (not extra runtime downloads):
Three.js r169, commit 37d6f280a5cd642e801469bb048f52300d31258e
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r169
XR grabbing highlight, ring reticle, and PositionalAudio HRTF examples.
Adapted for touchscreen aim and native Web Audio in app.js.
Three.js MIT license: THREE-LICENSE.txt. Detailed source links are in README.md.

Additional source references reviewed for this iteration:
Enva-XR LightProbe (environment lighting):
https://github.com/tentone/enva-xr/blob/main/src/object/LightProbe.ts
pinball-xr TableAudio (position- and speed-dependent impact audio):
https://github.com/patrick-s-young/pinball-xr/blob/main/src/audio/TableAudio.js
A-Frame Physics spring and grab examples (damping and grab/release states):
https://github.com/c-frame/aframe-physics-system/blob/master/examples/cannon/spring.html
https://github.com/c-frame/aframe-physics-system/blob/master/examples/components/grab.js
These are implementation references; no additional runtime from these projects is bundled.
The exact inspected source blob IDs are recorded in README.md.

8-Frame 1.5.0, unmodified official example artifact:
https://github.com/8thwall/aframe-world-effects-example/tree/582b28a94182f0243346f1c22df4b49091dbf2ad
File SHA-256: 7617f92c289abf00ef6fbc6bfee35944f6c4c2b1e1200e8e8d4cc58ea4a067af
MIT notices: 8FRAME-LICENSE.txt, AFRAME-LICENSE.txt and bundled notices.

The engine is loaded locally; no hosted-service account or API key is used.
